Free Trial Lesson Gradings Contacts Shop Book a Free tRial About us A Tremendous and Dynamic Olympic and Paralympic Sport Judo is a tremendous and dynamic combat sport that demands both physical prowess and great mental discipline. From a standing position, it involves techniques that allow you to lift and throw your opponents onto their backs. On the ground, it includes techniques that allow you to pin your opponents down to the ground, control them, and apply various choke holds or joint locks until submission. Providing Judo for The Communities of South Yorkshire South Yorkshire Judo Academy will officially open on Tuesday 13th January 2026, launching our first dojo at Green Gate Lane Academy, Greengate Lane, High Green, Sheffield, S35 3GS. South Yorkshire Judo Academy is part of the DNA Judo group; one of only three organisations in the UK to hold British Judo Association Elite Provider status. Our aim is to deliver high-quality judo in a safe, positive and inspiring environment. We will offer weekly sessions for judoka aged 4 years through to adults, welcoming everyone from complete beginners to experienced players. Our sessions are designed to be fun, engaging and challenging, while supporting long-term development both on and off the mat.
